/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Epic support
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Add epic as a first-class issue type: hierarchy via parent_id, Epics screen with progress rollups, epic badges on board and backlog, epic picker in the issue detail sheet.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Subtasks
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Child issues under stories, tasks, and bugs using the same parent_id column, with progress rollup on the parent issue.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Global search & filters
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Quick search across issues and wiki pages, JQL-lite filter bar (assignee, type, label, status), and saved filters.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Notifications & @mentions
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: In-app notification inbox, @mentions in comments, wiki page watching — wiring up the existing notification settings toggles.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Time tracking
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Original estimates, work logs, and remaining-time display on issues, building on the original_estimate and time_spent columns.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Releases & components
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Fix versions and components on issues, plus a release hub screen with per-version progress.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Roadmap / timeline
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Gantt-style timeline view of epics and sprints across time.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Board power-ups
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Swimlanes (by assignee/epic), per-column WIP limits, and multi-select bulk edit on the board.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Custom workflows
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Configurable statuses and board columns per project instead of the fixed four-status workflow.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Automation rules
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Trigger → condition → action rules, e.g. "when all subtasks done, move parent to done".

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki: collaboration
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Inline comments on wiki page text and page-level restrictions/permissions.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki: publishing
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Page export (PDF/Markdown), macros (table of contents, status badges, issue embeds), and blog posts per space.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Insights inbox
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Capture customer feedback as insights, triage an inbox, and link evidence to features with importance and quotes.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Features & prioritization
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A prioritized product backlog scored by tier-weighted user impact, RICE, and votes, with a value/effort matrix.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Customers & segments
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Companies with tiers (strategic/growth/standard) whose weights drive feature impact, plus customer contacts.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Objectives (OKRs)
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Outcome objectives with status and target dates, linked to the features that move them, with delivery rollups.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Product roadmap
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A Now/Next/Later roadmap of features with drag-to-reschedule and push-to-delivery into epics/issues.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Idea portal & polish
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A customer-facing idea portal with voting and idea submission, plus JQL-lite search and done-category epic rollups.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki UX overhaul
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Make the wiki a world-class knowledge base: document reading layout, breadcrumbs, sticky on-this-page outline, decluttered action bar, refined prose typography, space hero with Pages/Blog tabs, home polish, and a comfortable editor.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki AI assistant
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Rovo-style AI in the wiki via the Anthropic API (server-side proxy): page summaries, an in-editor writing assistant (draft/improve/shorten/expand/fix), and ask-your-wiki Q&A with citations. Degrades gracefully when no API key is configured.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Email notifications
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: SMTP delivery for notifications, gated on config and degrading to a no-op with an in-memory outbox when unconfigured; respects each user's toggles.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki page attachments & inline images
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Upload files to wiki pages and embed images inline; signed raw URLs, stored unsigned and re-signed per fetch so content never expires.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: API tokens & webhooks
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Personal API tokens (hashed, Bearer auth) and HMAC-signed outbound webhooks on issue events, managed from a Developer settings card.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Real-time updates (SSE)
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: In-process event bus + SSE stream endpoint; the board and notification bell update live as teammates make changes.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Custom fields
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Per-project custom field definitions (text/number/select/date/checkbox) with type-validated values rendered and edited on every issue.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: E2E verification harness
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Playwright suite that boots the real backend + built SPA and drives it headless: login, every main route renders, and key flows. The verification layer the app was missing.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Ops & rate limiting
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: General per-IP API throttle as an abuse safety net (stream/health exempt), alongside the existing baseline security headers and login limiter.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: List pagination
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Opt-in pagination on the issues list (X-Total-Count) that stays backward-compatible with the board; confirmed other list endpoints are bounded.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Schema migration runner
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: An ordered, append-only migration list recorded in a schema_migrations ledger, replacing the try/catch ALTERs that swallowed errors and left no record of what ran. One migration list drives both sql.js and MySQL.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Batched issue enrichment
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Issue enrichment fired ~11 queries per issue, so a 100-issue board cost 719 queries per request. Batched reads keyed by the ids in the list bring that to a flat 12, with the payload byte-identical.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Live issue chips
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Issue keys in wiki pages resolve to real issues: hover shows title, status, assignee and priority, and clicking always opens the issue named. Keys that resolve to nothing stay prose, so COVID-19 and ISO-8601 no longer render as links.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Page back-links
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The reverse direction, which did not exist: an issue shows which wiki pages mention it, filtered through page restrictions so a restricted page never discloses its title.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Flow metrics
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Cycle time, time-in-status, and cumulative flow mined from the status history in activity_log — including the fix that made board moves write that history at all.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: JQL table macro
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A [jql: …] block in a wiki page renders a live, always-current issue table via the existing search endpoint. Parse errors render inline; query text never creates back-link rows.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: MySQL migrations in CI
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The suite runs on sql.js, so the migration runner's MySQL branch shipped verified only by hand. CI now applies every migration against a real MySQL service, including the ledger-less upgrade path an existing deployment takes.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Page approvals
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Version-pinned sign-off on wiki pages: editing an approved page marks it stale rather than silently keeping a verified badge, and the approval log is append-only so revoking preserves history.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki task lists
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Checkbox items in wiki pages, with state stored outside the page body so ticking a box is not an edit: no version bump, no history row, and an approved page stays approved.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Action items to issues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Convert a page task into a real tracked issue, linked both ways: the task shows the issue key and its live status, and the issue lists the page it came from. Idempotent — converting twice returns the same issue.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki focus mode
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Full-width distraction-free reading and editing: the page fills the window, both sidebars collapse, and the choice persists per user.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Service desk foundation
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Requests as first-class issues: service-desk projects, request types with a validated field schema, and public/internal comment visibility so an agent can take a note the customer never sees.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Help center
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The customer-facing surface: browse request types, raise a request, track it, reply, and resolve it — behind a single allow-list projection so no internal field can reach a customer.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Agent queues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Named, saved JQL views over a service desk project, with live counts in the sidebar from a single grouped query and bulk actions on the rows.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Insight capture
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Turn text that already exists in Atlas — a service desk request, an issue comment, a wiki passage — into a triageable insight. The excerpt is snapshotted rather than joined, so evidence survives its source being edited or deleted.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: SLAs
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: First response and resolution goals per request type, derived on read rather than fired by a scheduler: clocks store timestamps, and one slaState() helper turns them into a badge, a detail panel and a report that cannot disagree.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Revenue-weighted demand
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Rank features by the ARR behind them, not just a three-point tier proxy, with a breakdown naming the companies that asked. Sits alongside user_impact rather than redefining it — where the two disagree, the disagreement is the finding.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Knowledge base deflection
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Wiki articles offered while a customer describes their problem, bounded to the spaces an admin curated into so the internal wiki can never leak. Hits and "this solved it" are recorded, which makes the deflection rate a measured number rather than a claim.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Theme clustering
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A named grouping of insights between feedback and features, so two hundred insights stop being two hundred rows. Grouping is manual and works with no API key; the model only ever proposes, and a human confirms through the same endpoint a hand-made theme uses.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: CSAT and the service desk report
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: One satisfaction rating per request, editable while it stays resolved and enforced to the reporter server-side, plus a report whose every panel counts only rows we store — labelled since tracking began, with no backfill invented for requests that predate a goal.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Spec drafting
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Turn a feature and its evidence into a draft spec page in the wiki. Assembly is pure and always works; the model adds prose when configured, and a model failure still leaves an editable skeleton.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Outcome tracking
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Close the loop after launch with declared success measures, durable launch dates, post-launch feedback signals, and a review queue that makes unexamined launches visible.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Portal v2
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Close the customer feedback loop with an anonymous public roadmap, safe feature detail, follows, a personal submissions view, and status-change notifications through the existing in-app and email delivery path.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: JQL v2 and SLA-aware queues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A real query parser with grouping, OR, NOT, IN and EMPTY operators, plus persisted SLA boundaries that make breached and at-risk work queues fast, portable and consistent with every SLA badge.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Customizable dashboard gadgets
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Personal, project-specific dashboards with an ordered gadget catalogue, responsive widths, useful delivery views and an atomic server-validated layout contract.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Personal JQL saved filters
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: First-class personal, project-scoped JQL views with a validated typed contract, editable saved queries, inline errors and permanent issue result links.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Epic support
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Add epic as a first-class issue type: hierarchy via parent_id, Epics screen with progress rollups, epic badges on board and backlog, epic picker in the issue detail sheet.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki UX overhaul
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Make the wiki a world-class knowledge base: document reading layout, breadcrumbs, sticky on-this-page outline, decluttered action bar, refined prose typography, space hero with Pages/Blog tabs, home polish, and a comfortable editor.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki AI assistant
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Rovo-style AI in the wiki via the Anthropic API (server-side proxy): page summaries, an in-editor writing assistant (draft/improve/shorten/expand/fix), and ask-your-wiki Q&A with citations. Degrades gracefully when no API key is configured.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Email notifications
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: SMTP delivery for notifications, gated on config and degrading to a no-op with an in-memory outbox when unconfigured; respects each user's toggles.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki page attachments & inline images
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Upload files to wiki pages and embed images inline; signed raw URLs, stored unsigned and re-signed per fetch so content never expires.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: API tokens & webhooks
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Personal API tokens (hashed, Bearer auth) and HMAC-signed outbound webhooks on issue events, managed from a Developer settings card.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Real-time updates (SSE)
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: In-process event bus + SSE stream endpoint; the board and notification bell update live as teammates make changes.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Custom fields
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Per-project custom field definitions (text/number/select/date/checkbox) with type-validated values rendered and edited on every issue.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: E2E verification harness
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Playwright suite that boots the real backend + built SPA and drives it headless: login, every main route renders, and key flows. The verification layer the app was missing.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Ops & rate limiting
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: General per-IP API throttle as an abuse safety net (stream/health exempt), alongside the existing baseline security headers and login limiter.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: List pagination
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Opt-in pagination on the issues list (X-Total-Count) that stays backward-compatible with the board; confirmed other list endpoints are bounded.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Schema migration runner
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: An ordered, append-only migration list recorded in a schema_migrations ledger, replacing the try/catch ALTERs that swallowed errors and left no record of what ran. One migration list drives both sql.js and MySQL.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Batched issue enrichment
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Issue enrichment fired ~11 queries per issue, so a 100-issue board cost 719 queries per request. Batched reads keyed by the ids in the list bring that to a flat 12, with the payload byte-identical.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Live issue chips
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Issue keys in wiki pages resolve to real issues: hover shows title, status, assignee and priority, and clicking always opens the issue named. Keys that resolve to nothing stay prose, so COVID-19 and ISO-8601 no longer render as links.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Page back-links
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The reverse direction, which did not exist: an issue shows which wiki pages mention it, filtered through page restrictions so a restricted page never discloses its title.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Flow metrics
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Cycle time, time-in-status, and cumulative flow mined from the status history in activity_log — including the fix that made board moves write that history at all.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: JQL table macro
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A [jql: …] block in a wiki page renders a live, always-current issue table via the existing search endpoint. Parse errors render inline; query text never creates back-link rows.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: MySQL migrations in CI
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The suite runs on sql.js, so the migration runner's MySQL branch shipped verified only by hand. CI now applies every migration against a real MySQL service, including the ledger-less upgrade path an existing deployment takes.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Page approvals
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Version-pinned sign-off on wiki pages: editing an approved page marks it stale rather than silently keeping a verified badge, and the approval log is append-only so revoking preserves history.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki task lists
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Checkbox items in wiki pages, with state stored outside the page body so ticking a box is not an edit: no version bump, no history row, and an approved page stays approved.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Action items to issues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Convert a page task into a real tracked issue, linked both ways: the task shows the issue key and its live status, and the issue lists the page it came from. Idempotent — converting twice returns the same issue.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Wiki focus mode
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Full-width distraction-free reading and editing: the page fills the window, both sidebars collapse, and the choice persists per user.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Service desk foundation
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Requests as first-class issues: service-desk projects, request types with a validated field schema, and public/internal comment visibility so an agent can take a note the customer never sees.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Help center
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: The customer-facing surface: browse request types, raise a request, track it, reply, and resolve it — behind a single allow-list projection so no internal field can reach a customer.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Agent queues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Named, saved JQL views over a service desk project, with live counts in the sidebar from a single grouped query and bulk actions on the rows.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Insight capture
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Turn text that already exists in Atlas — a service desk request, an issue comment, a wiki passage — into a triageable insight. The excerpt is snapshotted rather than joined, so evidence survives its source being edited or deleted.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: SLAs
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: First response and resolution goals per request type, derived on read rather than fired by a scheduler: clocks store timestamps, and one slaState() helper turns them into a badge, a detail panel and a report that cannot disagree.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Revenue-weighted demand
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Rank features by the ARR behind them, not just a three-point tier proxy, with a breakdown naming the companies that asked. Sits alongside user_impact rather than redefining it — where the two disagree, the disagreement is the finding.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Knowledge base deflection
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Wiki articles offered while a customer describes their problem, bounded to the spaces an admin curated into so the internal wiki can never leak. Hits and "this solved it" are recorded, which makes the deflection rate a measured number rather than a claim.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Theme clustering
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A named grouping of insights between feedback and features, so two hundred insights stop being two hundred rows. Grouping is manual and works with no API key; the model only ever proposes, and a human confirms through the same endpoint a hand-made theme uses.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: CSAT and the service desk report
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: One satisfaction rating per request, editable while it stays resolved and enforced to the reporter server-side, plus a report whose every panel counts only rows we store — labelled since tracking began, with no backfill invented for requests that predate a goal.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Spec drafting
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Turn a feature and its evidence into a draft spec page in the wiki. Assembly is pure and always works; the model adds prose when configured, and a model failure still leaves an editable skeleton.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Outcome tracking
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Close the loop after launch with declared success measures, durable launch dates, post-launch feedback signals, and a review queue that makes unexamined launches visible.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Product: Portal v2
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Close the customer feedback loop with an anonymous public roadmap, safe feature detail, follows, a personal submissions view, and status-change notifications through the existing in-app and email delivery path.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: JQL v2 and SLA-aware queues
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: A real query parser with grouping, OR, NOT, IN and EMPTY operators, plus persisted SLA boundaries that make breached and at-risk work queues fast, portable and consistent with every SLA badge.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Customizable dashboard gadgets
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: Personal, project-specific dashboards with an ordered gadget catalogue, responsive widths, useful delivery views and an atomic server-validated layout contract.

/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.title: Personal JQL saved filters
/projects/7c9679de-12ce-456a-b837-014298.description: First-class personal, project-scoped JQL views with a validated typed contract, editable saved queries, inline errors and permanent issue result links.

/wiki/pages/0e0f6b78-93ee-4452-a394-a71b.title: Getting access to a system
/wiki/pages/0e0f6b78-93ee-4452-a394-a71b.body:
Getting access to a system

Access is granted by the system owner, not the help desk. Raise an access request naming the system and why you need it, and it will be routed for approval.

Most approvals land within one working day.

/wiki/pages/1c7a060b-2d84-46d3-a9d3-e8bd.title: Laptop will not power on
/wiki/pages/1c7a060b-2d84-46d3-a9d3-e8bd.body:
Laptop will not power on

Hold the power button for 15 seconds, then plug the charger in directly (not through a dock) and wait two minutes before trying again.

If the charger light stays off, the power supply is the likely fault — raise a hardware request and mention which light you saw.

/wiki/pages/50394d0b-f80f-497c-9b61-857c.title: API Reference
/wiki/pages/50394d0b-f80f-497c-9b61-857c.body:
API Reference

Complete REST API documentation for the Atlas backend.

Authentication

All API requests (except login) authenticate with the session token returned by /api/auth/login:

x-auth-token: [session token]
Note: identity is taken from the session token only. x-user-id and x-user-role are ignored — sending them grants no access.

Endpoints

Auth

MethodPathDescription
POST/api/auth/loginLogin with email/password
GET/api/auth/meGet current user

Issues

MethodPathDescription
GET/api/projects/:id/issuesList project issues
POST/api/projects/:id/issuesCreate issue
PUT/api/issues/:idUpdate issue

/wiki/pages/5733cbd2-d6a2-4a4d-973b-0c64.title: Atlas PRD — Core Features
/wiki/pages/5733cbd2-d6a2-4a4d-973b-0c64.body:
Atlas PRD — Core Features

AuthorPriya Patel
StatusAPPROVED
Last UpdatedApril 8, 2026

Problem Statement

Engineering teams need a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to Jira that they can customize and deploy instantly.

User Stories

  • As a developer, I want to create and drag issues on a kanban board so I can track my work visually.
  • As a PM, I want to see dashboards and reports so I can make data-driven decisions.
  • As a team lead, I want role-based access so I can control who can modify what.

/wiki/pages/7685f403-1e0b-4f57-9a92-8473.title: Development Setup
/wiki/pages/7685f403-1e0b-4f57-9a92-8473.body:
Development Setup

Get your local development environment running in minutes.

Prerequisites

  • Node.js 18+ installed
  • Git
  • A code editor (VS Code recommended)

Quick Start

git clone https://github.com/KunalDSoni/Atlas.git
cd Atlas/backend
npm install
node server.js

Open http://localhost:3001 in your browser.

Environment Configuration

Copy .env.example to .env and configure:

VariableDefaultDescription
SEED_DEMO_DATAtruePopulate demo data on fresh DB
DB_DRIVERsqlitesqlite or mysql
⚠️ Warning: Delete data.db and restart if you change the schema — CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS won't add new columns.

/wiki/pages/a040c2a5-1548-4cf1-9e7f-b854.title: Incident Runbook
/wiki/pages/a040c2a5-1548-4cf1-9e7f-b854.body:
Incident Runbook

🚨 Critical: Follow these steps during any production incident. Do not skip steps.

Severity Levels

LevelImpactResponse TimeExample
SEV-1Complete outage15 minutesSite down, data loss
SEV-2Major degradation30 minutesLogin broken, slow responses
SEV-3Minor impact2 hoursUI bug, non-critical feature

Step-by-Step Response

  1. Acknowledge: Claim the incident in the team channel
  2. Assess: Determine severity and affected systems
  3. Communicate: Post status update within 10 minutes
  4. Mitigate: Apply immediate fix or rollback
  5. Resolve: Confirm services are restored
  6. Postmortem: Write blameless postmortem within 48 hours

/wiki/pages/ae84a2e0-bfe9-4c7e-a70d-923b.title: Architecture Overview
/wiki/pages/ae84a2e0-bfe9-4c7e-a70d-923b.body:
Architecture Overview

Atlas is built as a modern full-stack application with a clear separation of concerns.

System Architecture

The system follows a classic three-tier architecture: presentation layer (React SPA), application layer (Node.js + Express), and data layer (SQLite / MySQL).

Key Components

ComponentTechnologyPurpose
FrontendReact 18 + TypeScript + ViteSingle-page application built with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
BackendExpress 5REST API with modular route files
Databasesql.js / MySQLData persistence with migration support
AuthSession tokensx-auth-token session auth, scrypt-hashed passwords, RBAC

Data Flow

All API requests flow through the auth middleware which validates session tokens and attaches user context. Route modules handle business logic and database operations through shared helper functions.

ℹ️ Note: The frontend uses Babel standalone for JSX transformation, which means no build step is required during development.

Laptop will not power on

Hold the power button for 15 seconds, then plug the charger in directly (not through a dock) and wait two minutes before trying again.

If the charger light stays off, the power supply is the likely fault — raise a hardware request and mention which light you saw.

/wiki/spaces/fcc46c29-00a2-4ef9-b475-87c.title: Architecture Overview
/wiki/spaces/fcc46c29-00a2-4ef9-b475-87c.body:
Architecture Overview

Atlas is built as a modern full-stack application with a clear separation of concerns.

System Architecture

The system follows a classic three-tier architecture: presentation layer (React SPA), application layer (Node.js + Express), and data layer (SQLite / MySQL).

Key Components

ComponentTechnologyPurpose
FrontendReact 18 + TypeScript + ViteSingle-page application built with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
BackendExpress 5REST API with modular route files
Databasesql.js / MySQLData persistence with migration support
AuthSession tokensx-auth-token session auth, scrypt-hashed passwords, RBAC

Data Flow

All API requests flow through the auth middleware which validates session tokens and attaches user context. Route modules handle business logic and database operations through shared helper functions.

ℹ️ Note: The frontend uses Babel standalone for JSX transformation, which means no build step is required during development.
